Job Description:

WHO WE ARE:

Exemplar Luxury Group is the largest multi-brand luxury retailer in the world, comprising Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus, Bergdorf Goodman and Saks OFF 5TH. Powered by our talented colleagues, we are redefining luxury shopping by offering each customer a personalized experience across our store network and e-commerce platforms. Through strong partnerships with the world’s most esteemed brands, cutting-edge technology and the industry’s most comprehensive luxury customer data, Saks Global is shaping the future of retail.

YOU WILL BE:

As the Assistant Buyer, you are a motivated individual who will participate in vendor selections and partnerships. The Assistant Buyer will assist in providing information for the monitoring of inventory productivity, and the analysis of vendor profitability, while providing data and analysis for price changes, and assist in entering price changes online.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Order Management

  • Liaise with Buyers, Associate Buyers, and brand partners to gather and confirm order details (e.g., item details, shipping details, delivery schedules, order prioritization), manage updates to buy sheets, and resolve discrepancies
  • Oversee offshore Merchandise Assistants’ creation and transmission of purchase orders to brand partners, ensuring timely delivery and accuracy of order details, overseeing communication between Merchandise Assistants and brand partners, and resolving or escalating any issues raised
  • Provide allocation direction to the Planning Allocation team and help manage allocations for high-touch categories such as Designer
  • Manage communication of receipt flow changes to the offshore team and ensure POs are maintained to ensure accurate view of ship windows, order quantities, and on-order

Market Preparation

  • Prepare Buyers for Market through working with Planners to provide comprehensive insights on historical performance (e.g., best and worst sellers by door), emerging trends, customer preferences, coordinating market appointments and periodically attending NY market
  • Support Buyer in style-out sessions including coordinating logistics and preparing insights to support assortment presentation
  • Initiate the development of strategic product assortments to drive sales and brand growth

Bottoms-Up In-Season Analysis

  • Act as primary point of contact on execution questions and feedback from brand partners, visual merchandising, site merchandising, stores, digital, marketing (incl. promos), planning (incl. pricing)
  • Constantly review business performance in close collaboration with Assistant Planners, communicating bottoms-up style insights to Buyers, recommending in-season actions (e.g., ask the vendor for ATS on sold out item) and helping to prepare for monthly OTB
  • Manage markdown cadence and oversee offshore execution of price changes (frequency varies by category), RTVs, etc. and resolve any escalated issues
  • Collaborate with offshore reporting team to generate custom Buying reports, maintaining structural changes to views and ensuring timeline delivery by offshore teams on expected cadences

WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

Required Qualifications (Minimum Requirements):

  • Manages ambiguity well, self starter, and is able to thrive in a fast paced environment
  • Strong accountability, and ability to multitask and prioritize independently
  • Generates a variety of approaches to problem solving quickly including new and novel ideas.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and can be both direct but diplomatic and gain trust from others quickly.
  • You often go above and beyond your goals. You are a consistent performer with a proven track record in driving positive outcomes through objectives and measures within a large complex organization.
  • Open to new perspectives and is willing to try new ways of working in our evolving business
  • Strong knowledge of and ability to apply retail math concepts, including elements of markup, margin planning, open to buy, and inventory productivity measures (WOS, T/O, GMROI).
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing
  • Excellent computer skills including MS Word and Excel, Powerpoint, Google Sheets/Docs/Slides
  • Proficiency in systems (RFS, AMS, PCW, NuOrder)
  • 1 - 2 years' experience as an Assistant Buyer, preferably in a major department store

YOUR LIFE AND CAREER AT EXEMPLAR LUXURY GROUP:

  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation
  • Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate
  • Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)
  • An amazing employee discount

BENEFITS:

We offer the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, disability insurance, and a variety of additional voluntary benefits (such as critical illness, hospital and accident insurance).


Exemplar Luxury Group is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with Exemplar Luxury Group and would like to request special assistance or an accommodation, please contact .

Salary Range $59,000 - $79,000*

Compensation for this role varies by geographic location. The listed range reflects multiple markets, including higher-cost areas. Actual starting pay will be determined based on work location, experience, and other job-related factors.

Over The Moon is looking for a Merchandising Assistant dedicated to our Home, Tabletop and Children's categories. The ideal candidate is passionate about beautifully curated assortments and editorials, interested in becoming a buyer, and excited to learn and help grow our home and children's brand portfolio to drive sales, registry adds and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Brand Onboarding & Maintenance
  • Play a key role launching new brands on-site via hands-on support during the onboarding process.
  • Upload new products and seasonal collections to Shopify and our marketplace, making sure images, copy and tags align with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain up-to-date assortment information, including pricing updates, SKU changes, variants (patterns, sizes, sets) and archiving discontinued products.
  • Monitor brand and product performance (sales, sell-through, return rates), market conditions and brand feedback for the three categories.
  • Research and present new Home, Tabletop and Children's brands that align with Over The Moon's aesthetic, values and customer preferences.
  • Launch Calendar
  • Assist with launch calendar setup, oversight and brand launch checklists for Home, Tabletop and Children's.
  • Work cross-functionally with Operations, Marketing and Editorial to ensure brands and seasonal drops go live as planned.
  • Merchandising
  • Support Merchandiser to curate the Home, Tabletop and Children's category pages and keep them fresh and consistent with launches.
  • Support merchandising of Best of Registry, baby registry, holiday and seasonal edits (e.g. Tabletop Holiday and Summer).
  • Partner with the Registry team to flag top-performing brands and products for couples, parents-to-be and gift-givers.
  • Category Support
  • Support the Tabletop/Home and Children's leads with vendor communication, purchase order tracking and dropship compliance follow-ups.
  • Assist with pop-ups, campaign shoots and style-outs for the three categories.

Requirements

  • 0–2 years of experience in merchandising, buying or e-commerce retail; exposure to home, tabletop or children's categories a plus.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or other e-commerce and marketplace platforms a plus.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, with a keen eye for detail and design.
  • Passion for lifestyle and luxury products, with a natural ability to identify trends and customer preferences.
  • Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret sales data and market trends.
  • Self-starter who is collaborative and can work independently as well as with a team.
  • Proficient in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office (Excel/Sheets, including VLOOKUPs).
  • Experience with Canva and Photoshop a plus.

People Leader:

Client-Centric:

  • Lead or co‑lead commerce media portions of senior client touchpoints: explain what’s happening, why it matters, and what you recommend next with clear trade‑offs and expectations.
  • Ensure commerce media work connects to broader full‑funnel and cross‑channel plans (Search, Social, TVAD, Creative, CRM, Retail/Marketplace strategy), partnering with Client Partners and channel leads to align priorities and timing.

Channel Specific Expertise & The Tinuiti Way:

  • Standardize how your teams plan, execute, and report across retail media: launch readiness, QA discipline, pacing hygiene, change logs, and clear documentation so quality is repeatable.
  • Own the implementation of Commerce Media Tinuiti Way for your clients: enforce practical standards and coaching for platform roles, retail event playbooks, and day‑to‑day operational excellence.
  • Create a strong collaboration cadence across adjacent teams so commerce media isn’t siloed; ensure teams understand dependencies and handoffs.

Product-Led:

  • Sponsor adoption of reusable templates and workflows (brief intake, launch checklists, reporting views, testing templates) to reduce manual work and rework.
  • Collect structured platform and workflow feedback from the field and route it to senior commerce leadership and product/ops partners, prioritizing issues that unlock scale and reduce friction.

  • Set expectations for testing rigor and learning loops: clear hypotheses, clean setups, defined read timing, and documentation of what changed and what we learned.
  • Oversee measurement alignment and ensure learnings roll back into next‑cycle plans.

  • Lead 1–2 cross‑account initiatives per half that improve commerce media consistency or efficiency (e.g., QA upgrades, reporting standardization, testing ladders, retail event readiness processes).

  • Proven experience leading and developing teams (ICs and potentially first‑line managers), including performance management, QA oversight, and capability building.
  • Strong command of commerce media optimization and measurement concepts (ROAS/ACoS, NTB where available, incrementality concepts, experimentation basics, retail seasonality/event dynamics).

Job Summary

The Senior Vendor Manager is responsible for leading the evaluating, curating, and expanding the product assortment for the European region. This includes identifying high-potential brands, developing vendor partnerships, securing competitive commercial terms, and using data-driven insights to drive category and revenue growth.


The role requires strong commercial judgement and the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. The Regional Senior Buyer sources and manages brands that meet customer needs, comply with regional requirements, and align with market trends within Europe.


Job Expectations:

  • Work closely with the Director of Merchandising and collaborate with global merchandising teams as needed, to align on business strategies, priorities, and category direction
